source_text: A woman of the law, sworn to defend our city from crime...

structure.script_literal: "NeFlOp.Don’t be late, girls."

translation: Nie spóźnijcie się, dziewczyny.

source_text: I’m never late!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.I’m never late!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.I’m never late!"

translation: Ja się nigdy nie spóźniam!

source_text: I didn’t know judges could promote police personnel.

structure.raw_value: ObBaEx.I didn’t know judges could promote police personnel.
structure.script_literal: "ObBaEx.I didn’t know judges could promote police personnel."

translation: Nie wiedziałem, że sędziowie mogą awansować funkcjonariuszy policji.

source_text: Life’s full of surprises.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Life’s full of surprises.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Life’s full of surprises."

translation: Życie jest pełne niespodzianek.

source_text: I’m glad you’re back, Canmore.

structure.raw_value: ObFrOp.I’m glad you’re back, Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "ObFrOp.I’m glad you’re back, Canmore."

translation: Cieszę się, że wróciłeś, Canmore.

source_text: How is freedom feeling?

structure.raw_value: OaFrEx.How is freedom feeling?
structure.script_literal: "OaFrEx.How is freedom feeling?"

translation: Jak smakuje wolność?

source_text: Congratulations on the promotion, detective.

structure.raw_value: OaFrOp.Congratulations on the promotion, detective.
structure.script_literal: "OaFrOp.Congratulations on the promotion, detective."

translation: Gratulacje z okazji awansu, detektywie.

source_text: Hello, Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Hello, Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Hello, Your Honor."

translation: Dzień dobry, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: You’re looking great today, Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You’re looking great today, Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You’re looking great today, Your Honor."

translation: Świetnie dziś wyglądasz, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: No need to suck up, detective. Just enjoy your freedom.

structure.raw_value: JdBaEx.No need to suck up, detective. Just enjoy your freedom.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaEx.No need to suck up, detective. Just enjoy your freedom."

translation: Nie musisz mi się podlizywać, detektywie. Po prostu ciesz się wolnością.

source_text: Any reason you’re not in your office?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Any reason you’re not in your office?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Any reason you’re not in your office?"

translation: Jakiś powód, dla którego nie siedzisz w swoim gabinecie?

source_text: Always investigating something. Huh, detective?

structure.raw_value: JdFlDe.Always investigating something. Huh, detective?
structure.script_literal: "JdFlDe.Always investigating something. Huh, detective?"

translation: Zawsze coś śledzisz, co, detektywie?

source_text: Just asking.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Just asking.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Just asking."

translation: Tak tylko pytam.

source_text: I’m waiting for a phone call to the courtroom phone.

structure.raw_value: JdFlEx.I’m waiting for a phone call to the courtroom phone.
structure.script_literal: "JdFlEx.I’m waiting for a phone call to the courtroom phone."

translation: Czekam na telefon, który ma zadzwonić na salę rozpraw.

source_text: Remember, the location needs to be very scenic. Only the best for government housing.

structure.raw_value: JdBaDe.Remember, the location needs to be very scenic. Only the best for government housing.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaDe.Remember, the location needs to be very scenic. Only the best for government housing."

translation: Pamiętaj, miejsce musi być bardzo malownicze. W końcu to lokum dla przedstawiciela władz.

source_text: Did you know there are Koi fish that cost six figures?... I bet they have magic powers… No… I’m certain they have magic powers.

structure.raw_value: JdHaEx.Did you know there are Koi fish that cost six figures?... I bet they have magic powers… No… I’m certain they have magic powers.
structure.script_literal: "JdHaEx.Did you know there are Koi fish that cost six figures?... I bet they have magic powers… No… I’m certain they have magic powers."

translation: Wiesz, że karpie koi mogą kosztować sześciocyfrowe sumy?... Założę się, że mają magiczne moce… Nie… Jestem pewien, że mają magiczne moce.

source_text: Good luck with your fish.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Good luck with your fish.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Good luck with your fish."

translation: Powodzenia z rybami.

source_text: Magic fish.

structure.raw_value: JdAnDe.Magic fish.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnDe.Magic fish."

translation: Magiczne ryby.

source_text: Put any more thought into adding a koi pond? It’s a good investment.

structure.raw_value: JdFrEx.Put any more thought into adding a koi pond? It’s a good investment.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrEx.Put any more thought into adding a koi pond? It’s a good investment."

translation: Myślałeś jeszcze o tym, żeby założyć staw z karpiami koi? To dobra inwestycja.

source_text: Not quite, Your Honor. The jacuzzi is working out nicely.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Not quite, Your Honor. The jacuzzi is working out nicely.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Not quite, Your Honor. The jacuzzi is working out nicely."

translation: Nie całkiem, Wysoki Sądzie. Jacuzzi świetnie działa.

source_text: A shame. If you ever want advice on how to set up the pond, don’t be a stranger.

structure.raw_value: JdFrOp.A shame. If you ever want advice on how to set up the pond, don’t be a stranger.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrOp.A shame. If you ever want advice on how to set up the pond, don’t be a stranger."

translation: Szkoda. Gdybyś chciał porady, jak urządzić staw, wiesz, gdzie mnie znaleźć.

source_text: Are you messing with the phone, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: JdAnDe.Are you messing with the phone, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "JdAnDe.Are you messing with the phone, 1Hero?"

translation: Majstrujesz przy telefonie, 1Hero?

source_text: Oh… Sorry, judge.

structure.raw_value: McHaCl.Oh… Sorry, judge.
structure.script_literal: "McHaCl.Oh… Sorry, judge."

translation: Och… Przepraszam, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: I hope you find something in the Casula Forest, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: CaWoDe.I hope you find something in the Casula Forest, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoDe.I hope you find something in the Casula Forest, 1Hero."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że coś znajdziesz w Lesie Casula, 1Hero.

source_text: Good news! I found the perfect spot for… the state’s government housing.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Good news! I found the perfect spot for… the state’s government housing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Good news! I found the perfect spot for… the state’s government housing."

translation: Dobre wieści! Znalazłem idealne miejsce na… rządową posiadłość.

source_text: This looks amazing! I can build a fishing pier and maybe put some nice expensive Japanese koi fish in there.

structure.raw_value: JdHaAg^.This looks amazing! I can build a fishing pier and maybe put some nice expensive Japanese koi fish in there.
structure.script_literal: "JdHaAg^.This looks amazing! I can build a fishing pier and maybe put some nice expensive Japanese koi fish in there."

translation: Wygląda świetnie! Mogę zbudować pomost i wpuścić do stawu piękne, drogie japońskie karpie koi.

source_text: A koi pond for your mansion?

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.A koi pond for your mansion?
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.A koi pond for your mansion?"

translation: Staw z karpiami koi przy twojej rezydencji?

source_text: Government housing!

structure.raw_value: JdAnAg^.Government housing!
structure.script_literal: "JdAnAg^.Government housing!"

translation: Mieszkanie służbowe!

source_text: So we’re good?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So we’re good?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So we’re good?"

translation: Czyli wszystko załatwione?

source_text: Great work, detective.

structure.raw_value: JdFrOp^.Great work, detective.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrOp^.Great work, detective."

translation: Dobra robota, detektywie.

source_text: So does this mean my farm is safe… Your Honor?

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.So does this mean my farm is safe… Your Honor?
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.So does this mean my farm is safe… Your Honor?"

translation: Czy to znaczy, że moja farma jest bezpieczna… Wysoki Sądzie?

source_text: We’ll see… Now go back to your country bumpkin life and give that loud voice of yours a rest.

structure.raw_value: JdAnDe^.We’ll see… Now go back to your country bumpkin life and give that loud voice of yours a rest.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnDe^.We’ll see… Now go back to your country bumpkin life and give that loud voice of yours a rest."

translation: Zobaczymy… A teraz wracaj do swojego prowincjonalnego życia i daj odpocząć temu donośnemu głosowi.

source_text: Country bumpkin, huh?

structure.raw_value: CaAnDeNo1.Country bumpkin, huh?
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDeNo1.Country bumpkin, huh?"

translation: Prowincjuszka, co?

source_text: Excuse me, Your Honor, but it’s not like the state really needs two mansions.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Excuse me, Your Honor, but it’s not like the state really needs two mansions.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Excuse me, Your Honor, but it’s not like the state really needs two mansions."

translation: Wybacz, Wysoki Sądzie, ale chyba państwo nie potrzebuje dwóch rezydencji.

source_text: Government houses.

structure.raw_value: JdBaOp^.Government houses.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaOp^.Government houses."

translation: Rządowe mieszkania.

source_text: Right, government houses.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Right, government houses.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Right, government houses."

translation: Zgadza się, rządowe mieszkania.

source_text: Yes, good point.

structure.raw_value: JdBaOp^.Yes, good point.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaOp^.Yes, good point. "

translation: Tak, słuszna uwaga.

source_text: Very well, Miss Ray. The court will rescind the state seizure of your land.

structure.raw_value: JdBaEx^.Very well, Miss Ray. The court will rescind the state seizure of your land.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaEx^.Very well, Miss Ray. The court will rescind the state seizure of your land."

translation: W porządku, panno Ray. Sąd uchyla decyzję państwa o przejęciu pani ziemi.

source_text: Damn straight.

structure.raw_value: CaAnOp.Damn straight.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnOp.Damn straight."

translation: No ba!

source_text: Now if you’ll excuse me, I need to take a long overdue bathroom break.

structure.raw_value: JdWoCl^.Now if you’ll excuse me, I need to take a long overdue bathroom break.
structure.script_literal: "JdWoCl^.Now if you’ll excuse me, I need to take a long overdue bathroom break."

translation: A teraz, jeśli pani pozwoli, muszę wreszcie skorzystać z toalety.

source_text: I really need to stop eating spicy tacos.

structure.raw_value: JdWoCl^.I really need to stop eating spicy tacos.
structure.script_literal: "JdWoCl^.I really need to stop eating spicy tacos."

translation: Naprawdę muszę przestać jeść ostre tacos.

source_text: I won’t lose my farm!

structure.raw_value: CaHaAg.I won’t lose my farm!
structure.script_literal: "CaHaAg.I won’t lose my farm!"

translation: Nie stracę swojej farmy!

source_text: See? It all worked out.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.See? It all worked out.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.See? It all worked out."

translation: Widzisz? Wszystko dobrze się skończyło.

source_text: Only thanks to you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Only thanks to you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Only thanks to you, 1Hero."

translation: Tylko dzięki tobie, 1Hero.

source_text: If it had been left up to that judge, I don’t know what would’ve happened.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.If it had been left up to that judge, I don’t know what would’ve happened.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.If it had been left up to that judge, I don’t know what would’ve happened."

translation: Gdyby wszystko zależało od tego sędziego, nie wiem, co by się stało.

source_text: I’m sure you could’ve figured out a way.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I’m sure you could’ve figured out a way.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I’m sure you could’ve figured out a way."

translation: Jestem pewna, że i tak znalazłbyś jakieś wyjście.

source_text: Seeing as how we’re all alone here, maybe we could tarry a bit…

structure.raw_value: CaFrDe.Seeing as how we’re all alone here, maybe we could tarry a bit…
structure.script_literal: "CaFrDe.Seeing as how we’re all alone here, maybe we could tarry a bit…"

translation: Skoro jesteśmy tu sami, może trochę się zabawimy…

source_text: … and see how that would’ve played out?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.… and see how that would’ve played out?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.… and see how that would’ve played out?"

translation: …i zobaczymy, jak by się to potoczyło?

source_text: Oh?

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo4.Oh?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo4.Oh?"

translation: Ach tak?

source_text: Your Honor, my farm is in danger… Whatever shall I do?

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Your Honor, my farm is in danger… Whatever shall I do?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Your Honor, my farm is in danger… Whatever shall I do?"

translation: Wysoki Sądzie, moja farma jest zagrożona… Co ja pocznę?

source_text: Miss Carol Ray, you stand before the court to contest an order of the state. Please state your case.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Miss Carol Ray, you stand before the court to contest an order of the state. Please state your case.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Miss Carol Ray, you stand before the court to contest an order of the state. Please state your case."

translation: Pani Carol Ray, staje pani przed sądem, by zaskarżyć decyzję władz. Proszę przedstawić swoją sprawę.

source_text: I’m just a simple country farmer. My farm is everything to me.

structure.raw_value: CaWoOp.I’m just a simple country farmer. My farm is everything to me.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoOp.I’m just a simple country farmer. My farm is everything to me."

translation: Jestem zwykłą wiejską farmerką. Moja farma jest dla mnie wszystkim.

source_text: But then I received this order from the court, and…

structure.raw_value: CaWoEx.But then I received this order from the court, and…
structure.script_literal: "CaWoEx.But then I received this order from the court, and…"

translation: Ale potem dostałam to postanowienie z sądu i…

source_text: It says the state is taking my farm away!

structure.raw_value: CaSaCl.It says the state is taking my farm away!
structure.script_literal: "CaSaCl.It says the state is taking my farm away!"

translation: Państwo odbiera mi moją farmę!

source_text: Please, Your Honor, help me!

structure.raw_value: CaSaEx.Please, Your Honor, help me!
structure.script_literal: "CaSaEx.Please, Your Honor, help me!"

translation: Proszę, Wysoki Sądzie, niech mi pan pomoże!

source_text: I understand your plight, Miss Ray.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I understand your plight, Miss Ray.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I understand your plight, Miss Ray."

translation: Rozumiem pani położenie, panno Ray.

source_text: But there’s more to this matter, isn’t there? Something about Casula ruins.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.But there’s more to this matter, isn’t there? Something about Casula ruins.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.But there’s more to this matter, isn’t there? Something about Casula ruins."

translation: Ale jest tu coś jeszcze, prawda? Chodzi o ruiny Casula.

source_text: Yes, I recently discovered Casula ruins in a cave on my land.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.Yes, I recently discovered Casula ruins in a cave on my land.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.Yes, I recently discovered Casula ruins in a cave on my land."

translation: Tak, niedawno odkryłam ruiny Casula w jaskini na mojej ziemi.

source_text: And now the state is saying it has to preserve them.

structure.raw_value: CaWoDe.And now the state is saying it has to preserve them.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoDe.And now the state is saying it has to preserve them."

translation: A teraz państwo twierdzi, że trzeba je chronić.

source_text: That’s why they’re taking my land away, Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: CaWoEx.That’s why they’re taking my land away, Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoEx.That’s why they’re taking my land away, Your Honor."

translation: Dlatego odbierają mi ziemię, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: It’s a very serious matter, Miss Ray. The state has a responsibility to secure the history of the state’s indigenous culture.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.It’s a very serious matter, Miss Ray. The state has a responsibility to secure the history of the state’s indigenous culture.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.It’s a very serious matter, Miss Ray. The state has a responsibility to secure the history of the state’s indigenous culture."

translation: To poważna sprawa, panno Ray. Państwo ma obowiązek chronić historię rdzennej kultury tego regionu.

source_text: So I’m to be left out of hearth and home?

structure.raw_value: CaAnOp.So I’m to be left out of hearth and home?
structure.script_literal: "CaAnOp.So I’m to be left out of hearth and home?"

translation: Czyli mam zostać bez dachu nad głową?

source_text: You can’t do this to me!

structure.raw_value: CaMaAg.You can’t do this to me!
structure.script_literal: "CaMaAg.You can’t do this to me!"

translation: Nie możecie mi tego zrobić!

source_text: Order in the court! Miss Ray, you will calm yourself down, or I will hold you in contempt of the court.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Order in the court! Miss Ray, you will calm yourself down, or I will hold you in contempt of the court.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Order in the court! Miss Ray, you will calm yourself down, or I will hold you in contempt of the court."

translation: Proszę o spokój na sali! Panno Ray, proszę się uspokoić, inaczej ukarzę panią za obrazę sądu.

source_text: Of course, Your Honor!

structure.raw_value: CaWoCl.Of course, Your Honor!
structure.script_literal: "CaWoCl.Of course, Your Honor!"

translation: Oczywiście, Wysoki Sądzie!

source_text: Good. Now about your situation…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Good. Now about your situation…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Good. Now about your situation…"

translation: Dobrze. Wracając do pani sprawy…

source_text: The state has a strong case here. I’m afraid that if you have nothing more to add, I’ll have to rule in favor of the state.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.The state has a strong case here. I’m afraid that if you have nothing more to add, I’ll have to rule in favor of the state.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.The state has a strong case here. I’m afraid that if you have nothing more to add, I’ll have to rule in favor of the state."

translation: Państwo ma mocne argumenty. Jeśli nie ma pani nic więcej do dodania, będę musiał orzec na korzyść państwa.

source_text: Oh, no, Your Honor!

structure.raw_value: CaWoAg.Oh, no, Your Honor!
structure.script_literal: "CaWoAg.Oh, no, Your Honor!"

translation: O nie, Wysoki Sądzie!

source_text: As it turns out, I would like to offer up something for the consideration of the court.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.As it turns out, I would like to offer up something for the consideration of the court.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.As it turns out, I would like to offer up something for the consideration of the court."

translation: Właściwie chciałabym przedstawić sądowi coś, co może mieć znaczenie dla sprawy.

source_text: But it’s very sensitive. May I approach the bench, Your Honor?

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.But it’s very sensitive. May I approach the bench, Your Honor?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.But it’s very sensitive. May I approach the bench, Your Honor?"

translation: To jednak bardzo delikatna sprawa. Czy mogę podejść do ławy, Wysoki Sądzie?

source_text: Hmm, very well, Miss Ray. I’ll allow it.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Hmm, very well, Miss Ray. I’ll allow it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Hmm, very well, Miss Ray. I’ll allow it."

translation: Hmm, dobrze, panno Ray. Proszę.

source_text: You won’t regret it, Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.You won’t regret it, Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.You won’t regret it, Your Honor."

translation: Nie pożałuje pan, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: Damn, you got really serious at the end.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Damn, you got really serious at the end.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Damn, you got really serious at the end."

translation: Cholera, pod koniec zrobiłaś się naprawdę poważna.

source_text: I had to make sure I got the outcome I wanted.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I had to make sure I got the outcome I wanted.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I had to make sure I got the outcome I wanted."

translation: Musiałam mieć pewność, że sprawa zakończy się po mojej myśli.

source_text: Come on, I’ll see you home.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Come on, I’ll see you home.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Come on, I’ll see you home."

translation: Chodź, odprowadzę cię do domu.

source_text: Don’t worry about me. I’ll head home on my own in a minute.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Don’t worry about me. I’ll head home on my own in a minute.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Don’t worry about me. I’ll head home on my own in a minute."

translation: Nie martw się o mnie. Zaraz sama wrócę do domu.

source_text: You should get back to work.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.You should get back to work.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.You should get back to work."

translation: Wracaj do pracy.

source_text: Sticking around?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Sticking around?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Sticking around?"

translation: Zostajesz tu?

source_text: Just admiring your office, 1Hero. It’s quite lovely.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Just admiring your office, 1Hero. It’s quite lovely.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Just admiring your office, 1Hero. It’s quite lovely."

translation: Podziwiam tylko twoje biuro, 1Hero. Jest naprawdę ładne.

source_text: You might make the judge mad if he finds you hanging around here.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.You might make the judge mad if he finds you hanging around here.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.You might make the judge mad if he finds you hanging around here."

translation: Sędzia może się wkurzyć, jeśli przyłapie cię tu na kręceniu się bez celu.

source_text: Don’t you worry about that.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Don’t you worry about that.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Don’t you worry about that."

translation: Tym się nie martw.

source_text: Well, if you insist. I’ll see you later, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Well, if you insist. I’ll see you later, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Well, if you insist. I’ll see you later, Carol."

translation: Skoro nalegasz. Do zobaczenia, Carol.

source_text: See you later, studmuffin.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.See you later, studmuffin.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.See you later, studmuffin."

translation: Do zobaczenia, przystojniaku.
